∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ),
                (∀ (i : Fin q.m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
                  ∀ (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                    (O :
                      OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                        ∀ k < outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q,
                          ∀
                            (E :
                              Set
                                (Fin (k + 1) →
                                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d × outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d)),
                            MeasurableSet E →
                              ∀ (U : Set (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d × outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d)),
                                MeasurableSet U →
                                  have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                                  P
                                      {z |
                                        (fun j => outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.observedPair q O z.1 z.2 ↑j) ∈ E ∧
                                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.observedPair q O z.1 z.2 (k + 1) ∈ U} =
                                    ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.transitionDensity q f O k E U z ∂P

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal),
                Monotone τ →
                  ∀
                    (O :
                      OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                      ∀ (N : ℕ),
                        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q ≤ N →
                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                          have elapsed := fun z =>
                            ↑(OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q) (fun x => N) z.1 z.2).2;
                          Measurable elapsed ∧
                            ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                  elapsed z ∂P ≤
                                outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ q.m +
                                  ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q) *
                                    (ENNReal.ofReal q.ρ * outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ q.m +
                                      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - q.ρ) *
                                        (4 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.S)) ∧
                              (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample q.m q.n →
                                ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                    elapsed z ∂P ≤
                                  5 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.m +
                                    ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q) *
                                      (ENNReal.ofReal q.ρ * (5 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.m) +
                                        ENNReal.ofReal (1 - q.ρ) *
                                          (4 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.S)))

            ∀ (i : Fin q.n) (job : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job q.d q.m),

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ),
                (∀ (i : Fin q.m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
                  ∀ (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                    (O :
                      OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                        ∀ (N : ℕ),
                          outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q ≤ N →
                            have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                            have Q :=
                              ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw
                                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.serialInput q));
                            ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw
                                (fun z =>
                                  (fun j => outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.observedPair q O z.1 z.2 ↑j,
                                    outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.outputIndex z.1))
                                (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
                                  (fun w =>
                                    (fun j =>
                                      outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealTrace
                                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.serialInput q) f w ↑j,
                                      w.2.2))
                                  Q)
                                P ∧
                              ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw
                                (fun z =>
                                  (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q) (fun x => N) z.1
                                      z.2).1)
                                (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
                                  (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealOutput
                                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.serialInput q) f)
                                  Q)
                                P
